title: London temp_min cold z-score vs TTF close
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] London minimum temperature 15d z-score < -1.25 leads TTF close by 3 days with negative sign; trade long TTF=F 4d on cold [weather.london.temp_min -> finance.TTF=F.close]
message: Null: London temp_min vs TTF close r=0.002 (n=387), best lag 2d r=0.06, validity 0; long-TTF rule 53 trades hit 47%, excess +0.67%/trade, OOS 19 trades avg +1.4% - noise, not tradeable

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.london.temp_min rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 2 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
